## 1. 共通データのセット

```{r}

rm(list = ls(all = TRUE))

# libraries needed
library(tidyverse)  # most variable creation here uses tidyverse 
library(tidyselect) # used to select variables in FP_EVENTS.R
library(haven)      # used for Haven labeled DHS variables
library(labelled)   # used for Haven labeled variable creation
library(expss)      # for creating tables with Haven labeled data
library(rJava)      # required for xlsx package
library(naniar)     # to use replace_with_na function
```

## 2. データ処理

```{r}
# 必要なデータセットの抽出

# ソースコードのルートフォルダを指定
chap <- "Chap09_RH"

goAnalysis <- function(year){
  
  # 母親の雇用状態を追加
  keep_REC21 <- c("b3", "b4", "b5", "b9", "caseid", "bidx")
  keep_rec0111 <- c("caseid", "v005", "v008", "v012", "v021", "v022", "v025", 
                    "v106", "v190")
  keep_rec41 <- c("caseid", "midx", "m1", "m1d", "m2a", "m2b", "m2c", "m2d", 
                  "m2e", "m2f", "m2g", "m2h", "m2i", "m2j", "m2k", "m2l", 
                  "m2m", "m13", "m14", "m42c", "m42d", "m42e", "m43", 
                  "m45", "m60")
  keep_RE223132 <-c("caseid", "v208")
  keep_REC42 <- c("caseid", "v467b","v467c","v467d", "v467f")
  
  # 設定した年に基づいてファイルを読み込む
  df_REC21 <- open_endes_file(year, "REC21.sav") %>%
    rename_with(~ tolower(.x)) %>% # 変数名を小文字に変換
    add_missing_columns(keep_REC21) %>% select(all_of(keep_REC21))
  df_rec0111 <- open_endes_file(year, "REC0111.SAV") %>%
    rename_with(~ tolower(.x)) %>% # 変数名を小文字に変換
    add_missing_columns(keep_rec0111) %>% select(all_of(keep_rec0111))
  df_rec41 <- open_endes_file(year, "REC41.SAV") %>%
    rename_with(~ tolower(.x)) %>% # 変数名を小文字に変換
    add_missing_columns(keep_rec41) %>% select(all_of(keep_rec41))
  df_RE223132 <- open_endes_file(year, "RE223132.SAV") %>%
    rename_with(~ tolower(.x)) %>% # 変数名を小文字に変換
    add_missing_columns(keep_RE223132) %>% select(all_of(keep_RE223132))
  
  df_REC42 <- open_endes_file(year, "REC42.SAV") %>%
    rename_with(~ tolower(.x)) %>% # 変数名を小文字に変換
    add_missing_columns(keep_REC42) %>% select(all_of(keep_REC42))

  # 重複チェック
  duplicate_check(df_rec0111, "caseid", "df_rec0111")
  duplicate_check(df_REC21, c("caseid", "bidx"), "REC21")
  duplicate_check(df_rec41, c("caseid", "midx"), "df_rec41")
  duplicate_check(df_RE223132, "caseid", "df_RE223132")
  duplicate_check(df_REC42, "caseid", "df_REC42")

  print("データセットを結合します")
  IRdata <- df_REC21 %>% group_by(caseid) %>% 
    filter(bidx == 1) %>% ungroup() %>%   # 一番若い児童のBIDXを抽出
    inner_join(df_rec0111, by = "caseid") %>%
    left_join(df_rec41, by = c("caseid" = "caseid", "bidx" = "midx")) %>%
    left_join(df_RE223132, by = "caseid") %>%
    left_join(df_REC42, by = "caseid")

  print("データセットの結合が完了しました")
  print(paste("レコード数:", nrow(IRdata)))
  
  # 子供の年齢確認 v008 - b3
  IRdata <- IRdata %>%
    mutate(
      age = v008 - b3,
      wt = v005 / 1000000
    )
  print("wtおよび年齢変数を追加しました")
  
  # 13. 月齢24ヶ月未満の子供に制限
  #create subset of KRfile to select for children for IYCF indicators
  IRdata <- IRdata %>%
    filter(age < 24 & b9==0)
  print("月齢24ヶ月未満の子供に制限しました")
  duplicate_check(IRdata, "caseid", "IRdata")
  print(paste("レコード数:", nrow(IRdata)))
      

  # create analytic variables
  source(here(paste0(chap,"/RH_ANC.R")), local = environment())
  # Purpose: 	Code ANC indicators

  source(here(paste0(chap,"/RH_Probs.R")), local = environment())
  # Purpose: 	Code indicators for problems accessing health care 

  IRdata <- IRdata %>%
    mutate(year = year)
  
  vars_to_keep <- IRdata %>%
    select(starts_with("rc")) %>%
    names() %>%
    append(c("year", "caseid")) # add the variables we need to keep
  
  # print(vars_to_keep)
  # 順序を保って選択
  
  IRdata <- IRdata[, vars_to_keep]
  
  # 出力用のルートフォルダを指定
  output_dir <- file.path(gdrive_dir, "output", year) %>%
    normalizePath() %>%
    trimws() # 正規化してトリムする
  # 出力用のルートフォルダが存在しない場合は作成
  if (!dir_exists(output_dir)) {
    dir_create(output_dir)
  }
  
  # IRdata folderにrds形式で保存
  print(sprintf("save IRdata into output folder for %s", year))
  saveRDS(IRdata, paste0(output_dir, "/IRdata-rh.rds"))
  print("complete IRdata into output folder")
}

```

## 3. ループ実行

```{r}
#** ここから実行
for (yr in yearlist) {
  goAnalysis(yr)
}
```
